heroHeadline: Day 586: Sonora Tour Concludes in Ciudad Obregón on Mother's Day; Banxico Cuts to 6.50% — Signals End of Easing Cycle
heroSubtitle: On May 10, 2026 (Mother's Day), President Sheinbaum closed her three-day Sonora working tour in Ciudad Obregón with a Pensión Mujeres Bienestar delivery event for women aged 60–64 (bimonthly 3,100-peso transfers) and a small concert celebrating Sonoran mothers. She departed for Mexico City at approximately 4:00 PM to visit her own mother, Dr. Annie Pardo Cemo. The complete three-day tour delivered: the Seri Aqueduct at Punta Chueca (Day 1); Hospital General de Zona No. 15 inauguration in Hermosillo, Yaqui Land Restitution Decree, and Navojoa Canal delivery (Day 2); and the Bienestar Mother's Day event in Ciudad Obregón (Day 3). A significant economic update: Banxico cut its benchmark rate 25bps to 6.50% on May 7 in a 3-2 vote — the 15th consecutive cut and the terminal rate of the easing cycle. The Board explicitly signaled rate holds ahead; no further cuts expected through 2027. The broader backdrop: the Trump administration's review of all 53 Mexican consulates in the U.S. continues; the CIA-Chihuahua unauthorized drug operation probe remains active at the FGR; Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya is on 30-day leave under National Guard protection; and the USMCA first formal negotiating round is on track for the week of May 25.
